## Reference routes
* Route arc ids out of range: 0.
* Consecutive route arcs that do not share a node (route breaks): 14 across 11 trips.
* Routes contain fewer entries than GPS fixes (median 5.3 fixes per route arc) -> labels per fix must be derived (monotone alignment, see docs/methodology.md).
* After alignment, median GPS-to-reference distance is 4.7 m (per-trip median); 2.03% of fixes are farther than 60 m from their aligned arc and are marked unlabelled.

## Candidate generation
* With radius 50 m and K = 10 (no fallback) the training candidate miss rate is **1.22%** with 6.6 candidates per fix on average.
* Full sweep: `candidate_radius_sweep_train.csv`, figure `figures/07_candidate_radius_sweep.png`.

## Decisions taken
1. Invalid coordinates are dropped, rows are re-sorted by timestamp, duplicate timestamps keep the first fix.
2. Distances use per-trip UTM coordinates (never raw degrees).
3. GPS gaps > 30 s are flagged; the HMM breaks its chain on gaps it cannot bridge.
4. Fixes whose aligned reference arc is > 60 m away get label -1 and are excluded from supervised rows and accuracy denominators.
5. Reference routes are treated as reference, not error-free truth (route breaks exist).
